markets.name: Carrefour
markets.note: anchor; ENABLED + REWRITTEN 2026-07-11 (task 24, recon: task 23/.superpowers/sdd/task-23-lidl-zabka-recon.md). The Cloudflare bypass is no longer needed: the old direct-site path (recon 2026-07-02: requests GET www.carrefour.pl/ = 403 'Attention Required! | Cloudflare' WAF challenge, reproduced under Playwright headless chromium — no product JSON reachable) is REPLACED. Carrefour's real online catalog lives on Wolt, whose Carrefour hypermarket venues are reachable through the unauthenticated, plain-JSON consumer-api.wolt.com (no Playwright, no auth headers, just a normal browser User-Agent) — the SAME shared WoltVenueScraper base + endpoint model as Żabka (store 47). Pinned venue is 'Carrefour Jerozolimskie' (carrefour-jerozolimskie, module constant in carrefour_pl.py), a FULL central-Warsaw hypermarket (NOT a small 'Carrefour Express'-style dark store): 35 top-level / 319 leaf categories, grocery leaves ~100% barcode_gtin (EAN) coverage with page_token pagination. Full-catalog crawl (assortment category tree -> per-leaf-category items). See carrefour_pl.py + wolt_base.py docstrings for the endpoint model and the unit_info-under-counts-multipacks quantity caveat (quantity parsed from the product name instead). brand left None (no structured brand field on this feed). If the pinned slug 404s, fetch_products() re-discovers a live Carrefour venue via GET /v1/pages/venue-list/carrefour-all then a 'carrefour' venue search. NOTE: this venue is a hypermarket, so it also carries non-grocery departments (Moda/clothing, Artykuły domowe/homeware, Artykuły biurowe/office) — add category_deny_prefixes here (same mechanism as Auchan PL) if those should be excluded from ingest. Real fixtures captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/carrefour_wolt_category_sample.json, carrefour_wolt_assortment_tree_sample.json). category_deny_prefixes added 2026-07-11 (task 25): the 11,622-product full hypermarket catalog was inspected top+2nd-level (actual product names, not just labels). Two whole departments are durable general merchandise ('Artykuły biurowe' office/school, 'Moda' fashion) and are denied wholesale; under the mixed 'Dla dzieci' the toy/game leaves (Zabawki incl. 'Zabawki wodne', Lego, Gry) are denied; the large mixed 'Artykuły domowe' department is denied per-subtree for every durable leaf (industrial/car/kitchenware/tableware/lighting/bedding/RTV-AGD/party/cutlery/pans/batteries/cables/filter-jugs/shoe-care/DIY/candles/grave-candles/bottles/fitness/bike/computer/headphones/plant-care/insecticides + durable food containers and bakeware) while KEEPING its household consumables (Środki czystości cleaning, Kapsułki/Środki do prania laundry, Środki do naczyń/zmywarek dish, Worki na śmieci trash bags, Odświeżacze powietrza air fresheners, Ściereczki/Gąbki cloths & sponges, Serwetki napkins, Kostki do WC, and Artykuły jednorazowe foil/paper/bags). NOTE the deny prefix 'Artykuły domowe/Naczynia' also drops the small 'Naczynia jednorazowe' leaf and 'Artykuły domowe/Ręczniki' also drops 4 'Ręczniki papierowe' (str.startswith can't separate a prefix leaf from its longer sibling) — acceptable loss vs. importing ceramic tableware/bath towels as groceries. Verified: kept 9,183/11,622 (79.0%), 99.2% of kept resolve to a canonical category_map.json slug.

The direct zakupy.auchan.pl scraper (auchan_pl.py, webproductpagews v5/v6) had NEVER succeeded from the production droplet: the product API endpoints serve datacenter IPs an empty HTTP 202 (verified live — same curl = full JSON from a residential IP, '202 0' from the droplet; the /v1/categories taxonomy endpoint is NOT WAF'd, which is why every nightly run 'discovered 11 departments' then got 0 products; a homepage cookie-jar flow does not unblock it — IP-reputation gating, not a challenge). Result: prod Auchan prices were frozen at the 2026-07-11 local-machine bulk transfer. Pinned venue 'Auchan Wola' (auchan-wolla) — largest of the 15+ Warsaw Auchan venues surveyed 2026-07-23: 42 top-level / 361 leaf categories (vs Carrefour Jerozolimskie's 35/319 which yields ~11.6k raw). Wolt items carry barcode_gtin (EAN) on most grocery items — a strict upgrade over the EAN-less direct feed (Auchan flips from EAN-harvest receiver to mostly self-sufficient). Catalog is smaller than the direct-site 22.5k (a single venue's assortment); the stale direct-site rows age out via the 21-day prune TTL as this feed refreshes. category_deny_prefixes REBUILT 2026-07-23 against the live auchan-wolla assortment tree (Wolt category names differ from zakupy.auchan.pl's; several top-level names carry a trailing space — 'Dla zwierząt ' — preserved verbatim here): whole non-grocery departments denied (Zabawki incl. Same 'Naczynia'-prefix-also-drops-'Naczynia jednorazowe' caveat as Carrefour (startswith can't split a prefix leaf from its longer sibling) — acceptable loss. markets.name: Biedronka
markets.note: discounter; recon 2026-07-02: the corporate/leaflet site www.biedronka.pl/pl is gazetka-only (no catalog), BUT Biedronka also runs a genuine e-commerce storefront at https://zakupy.biedronka.pl/ (Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Demandware) — plain `requests` GET of both the homepage and category pages (e.g. /nabial/mleko/) = 200, real server-rendered product tiles, no Cloudflare/WAF, no Playwright needed. Each tile embeds a `data-product-gtm="{...}"` JSON attribute (GA4 ecommerce tracking) with clean name/id/price/brand/category fields — cleaner than parsing the visual price markup. No EAN/GTIN present anywhere (checked tile markup + a live PDP fetch) -> barcode left None. Real fixture captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/biedronka_sample.html, /nabial/mleko/, 10 real dairy products, 0 barcodes).

markets.name: Lidl
category_allow_prefixes: Światy potrzeb/Żywność i żywność w pobliżu/
markets.note: discounter; recon 2026-07-02: www.lidl.pl/ and its CMS category hub pages (e.g. /c/zywnosc-i-napoje/s10068374) are Nuxt-SSR content/teaser pages with no product grid (confirmed via Playwright too — no product/price XHR fired). BUT https://www.lidl.pl/q/search?q=<term> IS server-rendered with a genuine embedded Nuxt `__NUXT_DATA__` payload containing real current leaflet/shelf prices (title/brand/price/oldPrice/packaging/category/image), reachable via plain `requests`, no Playwright needed. EAN/GTIN exists in this payload ONLY on Lidl's general/durable-goods (NonFood) items, never on Food items -> barcode left None for groceries. Real fixture captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/lidl_pl_sample.json, /q/search?q=mleko, 11 real products across Food+NonFood, 0 barcodes). category_allow_prefixes added 2026-07-11 (task 18): the full-catalog crawl (6,308 products, 1,043 distinct raw_category breadcrumbs, see task-17 report) surfaced that Lidl PL's online search/category API is overwhelmingly a general-merchandise online shop (Moda/clothing 1,998; Dom & Urządzanie/furniture 1,216; Warsztat/tools 1,011; Sport i wypoczynek 458; Zdrowie & uroda 88 — all durable beauty appliances, not consumable toiletries; Świat zwierząt 48 — durable pet gear, zero pet food) that must never reach a grocery app. Only 3 breadcrumb branches were verified (by inspecting actual product names, not just label text) to be genuine food/household-consumables: literal 'Food' (4 products), the 13-leaf 'Światy potrzeb/Żywność i żywność w pobliżu/' subtree (48 products: ready meals, cold cuts, pork, ice cream, frozen fish, oil, fruit, veg, cheese, savory snacks, dried fruit/nuts, rice/pasta/legumes), and 'Kategorie/Produkty spożywcze i środki czystości/' (2 products: Lupilu baby diapers + a mislabeled baby bodysuit). Alcohol ('Światy potrzeb/Wino, piwo i napoje spirytusowe/', 27 products) and all durable pet/beauty/kitchen-appliance branches were deliberately left OUT of the allow list — no canonical Cheep category fits them and several are mixed alcoholic/non-alcoholic. Net effect: ~54 of 6,308 products pass the domain filter; the rest is Lidl's durable-goods catalog, out of scope for a grocery price app.

markets.note: convenience; REWRITTEN 2026-07-11 (task 24, recon: task 23/.superpowers/sdd/task-23-lidl-zabka-recon.md). The old zabka.pl homepage-carousel scraper (~8 curated tiles, no EAN, no full catalog) is REPLACED: Żabka's real online catalog is not on zabka.pl/jush.pl at all -- it lives on Wolt, whose 'Żabka Jush' quick-commerce dark-store venues are reachable through the unauthenticated, plain-JSON consumer-api.wolt.com (no Playwright, no auth headers, just a normal browser User-Agent) -- via the shared WoltVenueScraper base (scrapers/wolt_base.py), the same base Carrefour (store 40) uses. One pinned Warsaw venue (zabka-jush-srodmiescie, module constant in zabka.py) exposed a full 2,128-SKU catalog across 138 leaf categories, 98.5% carrying a barcode_gtin (EAN) field -- a categorically better source than the old carousel or lidl.pl's own search API. Full-catalog crawl (assortment category tree -> per-leaf-category items with page_token pagination); see wolt_base.py's module docstring for the endpoint model, quantity-parsing caveat (unit_info under-counts multipacks; quantity is parsed from the product name instead, same fix biedronka.py already uses), and why brand is left None (no structured brand field on this feed). category_deny_prefixes excludes the 3 alcohol-only top-level categories (Piwa/beer, Alkohole mocne/spirits, Wina/wine -- each 18+-gated per the venue's own description) via the shared pipeline's raw_category prefix filter, same mechanism as Auchan PL/Lidl PL; no tobacco category exists in the tree (not legally sold via PL delivery apps) so no tobacco filter was needed. Real fixtures captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/zabka_wolt_category_sample.json, zabka_wolt_assortment_tree_sample.json). category_deny_prefixes extended 2026-07-11 (task 25): the full 2,252-product catalog was inspected — beyond the 3 alcohol departments, the 'Dom i wypoczynek' (home & leisure) department mixes household consumables (Kuchnia/Porządki cleaning, Pranie laundry — KEPT) with genuine non-grocery, so its 'Drobiazgi i akcesoria GSM' (lighters, batteries, SIM starters, copy paper, cigarette tubes) and 'Pomysł na prezent' (socks, gift bags, LEGO) leaves are denied, plus the single 'Warzywa i owoce/Kwiaty' leaf (a live potted plant).
